name: set_selected_object_proximity_radius

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetSelectedObjectProximityRadius converts the top value to float, passes it to func_00123350 for the selected object, and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: func_00123350 stores radius at offset 0x44 of the selected object's runtime descriptor and fixes its two proximity-test mode bytes at offsets 0x5E and 0x5F to 0 and 3. func_0012CBD8 reads the same radius and mode bytes when testing another object's horizontal distance, vertical separation, and facing relationship. The JP corpus contains 262 calls.
